nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values:
[VISUAL]
A young boy with dark skin, short black hair, and a warm smile stands in the foreground of a lush green field at sunset. He wears a maroon shirt over white dhoti. His palms are cupping his lips since he is shouting, as in the reference photo. The sun sets behind distant hills to the right, casting golden light across rolling fields and illuminating clouds above the horizon. In front of him are several sheep grazing peacefully along a dirt path that winds through the meadow toward small huts built from wood and straw roofs nestled among trees on gentle slopes. A few other animals graze nearby as well. The sky shows hues of orange, pink, and purple blending into darker tones near the mountains. This scene appears serene yet vibrant due to its rich colors and natural textures.

The image is captured from eye level using a medium shot focused centrally on the child who occupies most of the frame. There's an expansive view showing both close-up detail of the boy’s face—his bright eyes reflecting joy—and wide landscapes stretching far beyond. Composition emphasizes depth by placing the figure prominently against vast open spaces filled with pastoral life, creating balance between human presence and nature. Natural sunlight filters softly downward, enhancing the peaceful atmosphere without harsh contrasts or deep shadows. Overall, it evokes calmness and harmony within this idyllic rural setting during twilight hours.

[SPEECH]
Help, help. The wolf is attacking my sheep.

[SOUNDS]
boy shouting.
